comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_USEFULNESS_BACKFILL_IDLE_20261107 — the hourly usefulness-backfill lane must state the
reviewed idle reason (no_new_input) and its produced/attempted counts in its LaneRunReceipt, so a run that
has nothing to score grades GOOD (idle) instead of EMPTY "the receipt does not say why" (LQ-20261107-120).
